title: feat(account): a Notification Settings page for each person's own notification preferences
body:
Fixes #34728

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:账户应用新增「通知设置」页。每个人可以按主题 × 渠道开关通知,并设置摘要和免打扰时段。新增只读接口 `GET /api/v1/messaging/me/preferences`,`member_default` 增加对 `sys_notification_preference` 的读、建、改授权(不含删除),以及只约束普通成员(`org_member`)的本人行策略。
- 为什么改:#34728 要一个个人通知偏好页。裁决 6968686390(路线 A)定了只读新路由加数据门写入,裁决 6969143776 定了策略形状:行范围加写检查加 `positions: ['org_member']`。
- 风险与回滚:风险集中在新的成员行策略。如果写检查失效,成员可以把自己的行改给别人或改成组织默认。测试和两次消融都钉住了这一点。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,管理员的 Setup 网格从未改动。
- 先看:① `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`(`sys_notification_preference_self` 策略和授权行);② `packages/services/service-messaging/src/preference-resolver.ts`(`effectiveFor`,与 `emit` 同一套解析);③ `packages/services/service-messaging/src/my-preferences-routes.ts`(门的拒收顺序)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/default-permission-sets.notification-preference.integration.test.ts`,预期 16/16 通过。
- 需要你做的:对合同评审 F1(授权未限定范围,而行策略只约束 `org_member`)作补充裁决;本 PR 未改裁决过的策略形状。冻结期内保持 draft,不置 ready。

## What changes

- **Permission (ruling 6969143776).** `member_default` grants `sys_notification_preference` read/create/edit, with no delete. It adds the policy `sys_notification_preference_self`:
  - `operation: 'all'`;
  - `using: 'user_id == current_user.id'`;
  - `check: 'user_id == current_user.id'`;
  - `positions: ['org_member']`.

  `external_default` is unchanged. Admin Setup-grid access is unchanged.
- **Resolver.** `PreferenceResolver.effectiveFor(userId, organizationId, topics, channels)` builds the effective matrix from the same index and lookup `filter()` uses. It reads under the documented `EFFECTIVE_PREFERENCES_SYSTEM_CONTEXT` and never fails open. `MessagingService.effectivePreferencesFor` delegates to it.
  - (fix round 3, L1 M1 / review F2) It reads only what the answer needs: the caller's rows and the organization's default rows. Each is read by equality on `user_id` under the `organization_id` term: the caller's id, `null` and `''`, the stored spellings `isGlobalDefaultUser` accepts. This is the equality shape `loadRows` uses.
  - No other person's row is read.
  - A read that answers more than `EFFECTIVE_PREFERENCES_READ_CAP` (10000) rows rejects, so the door answers `500`, never a partial matrix.
  - The `Effective*` return types are exported from the package index (review F5). The route docblock states the no-organization case (review F3).
- **Route.** `GET /api/v1/messaging/me/preferences` (`my-preferences-routes.ts`) is mounted by `MessagingServicePlugin`. It keeps the preference-options posture: caller resolution, then held sign-in `403`, then anonymous `401`, then an empty closed query set (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`), then `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` on any unreadable source. It is added to the messaging route ledger and to the `check-route-envelope` MODULES declaration (zero counts, shared `sendOk`/`sendError`).
- **Account app.** The nav entry `nav_account_notification_settings` (`componentRef: 'account:notification_settings'`, `requiresService: 'messaging'`) is added in all 11 app translation packs.
- **Console page.** `NotificationSettingsPage` in `@object-ui/app-shell`:
  - reads through the host's authenticated `SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch`;
  - writes the person's own rows through `useAdapter()`, then reads the door again;
  - disables switches on mandatory topics ("Always delivered");
  - names each cell's source;
  - shows channels as columns in the door's order, so Slack (#34730) will need no page change.

  The `notificationSettings` namespace is added to every `@object-ui/i18n` pack, with zh-Hant generated by `gen:zh-hant`.
- **Only values that take effect are offered (fix round, option B).** The rule, measured in `preference-resolver.ts`:
  - `parseDigest` reads a stored `digest` only as `'daily'` or `'weekly'`. A stored `'none'` (the field's `defaultValue`), an empty value or anything else is "no opinion". `resolveDigest` then falls through, (user, topic, `*`) → (user, `*`, `*`) → the organization's rows → no digest.
  - `parseQuietHours` reads `quiet_hours` only as a window with both `start` and `end`. An empty value falls through the same way in `resolveQuietHours`.
  - So saving `'none'` or an empty window never turns off a digest or quiet hours that is in force. It only lets the next row decide, and the door does not say what that row holds.

  On the page:
  - **Digest:** while a digest is in force (source `own` or `default`), only Daily and Weekly are offered, and a hint says why "No digest" is not. "No digest" is listed only while it is already the effective value (source `builtin`).
  - **Quiet hours:** Save is enabled only for a complete window. Clearing a window that is in force shows a hint, and nothing is written.
  - **Writes:** `generalWrite` now takes only overriding values in its type: `digest` is `'daily' | 'weekly'`, and `quiet_hours` is a window, never `null`.
  - The "own (`*`, `*`) row shadows more specific defaults" warning is unchanged.
- **CI reds at the first head (3d8f3a0831), fixed:**
  - Lint UI: the quiet-hours face is resolved once at module scope (react-hooks: cannot create components during render).
  - Test UI: the `affordanceGrantMap-12082` write census enters `sendPreferenceWrite` create/update as `outOfFamily` (the caller's own row, refused otherwise by the server's row scope and write check).
  - Test Core: `connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts` counts the account app's served nav at 15 with the new entry.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/34728-notification-settings.md` (patch × 5).

## Tests

Head `08d51040cf` (earlier heads `6801953715`, `3d8f3a0831`).

- `plugin-security` `default-permission-sets.notification-preference.integration.test.ts` runs 16 tests on a real kernel with SqlDriver and SecurityPlugin. It pins the readings of report 6968930571 as `mapDataError` code+status.
  - **Member:**
    - may create, list and edit their own rows;
    - delete is refused `403`;
    - a create whose `user_id` is omitted, `null`, `''` or bob's is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, and nothing is stored;
    - moving their own row to bob or to empty is refused `403`, and the owner is kept;
    - moving an admin-written row of theirs is refused `403`;
    - the default row and bob's row answer `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` and are not listed.
  - **Admin:** lists every row, creates and edits the default, and edits bob's row.
  - **Emit effect:** alice's mute drops only her email channel. A mandatory topic is still delivered.
- (fix round 3) `my-preferences-routes.integration.test.ts` adds:
  - an organization holding more than the cap of another person's rows on each side of the caller's row and the default row: the caller's cell still answers `own` with its `ownRowId`, and the default cell answers `default`;
  - the caller's own rows past the cap: `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` and no data;
  - the leak test pins the three reads, each `organization_id` + `user_id` (caller, `null`, `''`).

  14 tests in the file.
- `service-messaging` `my-preferences-routes.integration.test.ts` checks:
  - the matrix and its sources;
  - the general own row;
  - cell-by-cell equality with `filter()`;
  - no leak of another person or organization;
  - the `401`/`403`/`400`/`500` refusals.

  The route-ledger conformance test is updated. `rbac-objects.test.ts` lists the new policy name.
- `app-shell`: `myPreferences.test.ts` and `NotificationSettingsPage.test.tsx` (22 tests) cover:
  - strict parse;
  - which write each change becomes;
  - a mandatory topic writing nothing;
  - the page drawing what the door answers;
  - a create or an update followed by a re-read;
  - a refused write being shown;
  - a failed read drawing no matrix;
  - locale key and placeholder parity;
  - registry resolution;
  - (fix round) with an organization default digest `'daily'`, the select offers only `daily`/`weekly`, shows the source `default` and the no-off hint;
  - with no digest in force, "No digest" is the current value and no hint is shown;
  - with organization quiet hours in force, clearing the window keeps Save disabled and writes nothing, while a complete window saves the own (`*`, `*`) row;
  - `digestChoices` / `quietHoursSaveable` unit cases.

  28 tests in total.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of claim surface, declared here:**
  - `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: the page's strings follow the `mobileApp` precedent.
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/package.json` devDependency, its `vitest.config.ts` source alias, and `pnpm-lock.yaml`: the integration test uses the real `NotificationPreference` object and `PreferenceResolver`.
  - `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`: the MODULES declaration that `check:route-envelope` requires for a new route module.
  - `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` and `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts`: census and count pins that the new write sites and the new nav entry move.
- **overlap-check against #34223:** it reports a conflict in `connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts`. The four conflict regions are #34223's own regions against `main`, the same four whether merged with `main` or with this branch. The one hunk this PR adds (line 224 to 231) is in none of them.
- **Members of `external_default`** can read the route but have no grant to write rows. This is unchanged by design and was not ruled.
- **A person's own `(*, *)` row** comes before the organization's rows in the lookup. Once it is written (digest or quiet hours), it decides every cell not set by a more specific row of theirs. The page says so beside the control.
- **Resolver behaviour, filed #35123:** a stored digest of `'none'` or an empty `quiet_hours` on a person's own row falls through to the organization default. It is not an override. Dedupe words: digest none override default, preference resolver fall-through, quiet hours empty user row. This PR does not change the resolver (not ruled). The page offers only values that take effect (above).
- **Emit's `loadRows` cap, filed #35136:** emit's `loadRows` reads with a per-topic cap of the same size (L1 N1). It is older than this PR and not in its surface.
- **Contract review F1, open with the maintainer:** the object grant in `member_default` carries no `positions` domain, while its row policy is domained to `org_member`. A principal that resolves `member_default` and holds neither `org_member` nor an administrator admission is not narrowed by any row policy on this object.
  - This was measured at this head through the real write gate and caller resolver.
  - `positions: ['org_member']` is ruled text, so this PR does not change the policy shape. The fix shape (a domained administrator widener, or a domain naming every non-administrator population) awaits a supplementary ruling.
  - The changeset now says that only the policy carries the `org_member` domain.
- **Contract review:** FAIL on F1, recorded at 6971590801. F2, F3 and F5 are taken in fix round 3. F4 (disabling controls for a caller with no write grant) is a follow-up, not this round.

  The first run, with the caller's row seeded after the bulk only, had left the `own` pin green under this mutation (2 failed). The pin was then re-seeded to bracket the row on both sides and re-run (3 failed). The restore proved blob == HEAD 5e9da8c84b11 and `git diff HEAD` empty.
